QuestInfo.0: Ask #b#p1012111##k how you can help him.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012111# says #t4032964# was mistakenly delivered to #o9101054#. Eliminate the #r#o9101054#s#k and find the #b#t4032964##k.\r\n\r\n#i4032964# #t4032964# #b#c4032964##k/1

0.0: I need something found. A friend of mine sent me a care package weeks ago, and it still isn't here.
0.1: So I called up the delivery center, and the box disappeared somewhere near the Golem's Temple. I think the #o5130101# may have already taken my #t4032964#. Can you get it back? I really need...what's inside.

yes.0: Go to the #bGolem's Temple#k and get the #b#t4032964##k back from the #r#o5130101#s#k. Don't worry, there's nothing breakable in the package. Speaking of which, DON'T OPEN IT.

no.0: I'm the one paying you. Why does it matter what's in the package?

1.0: That's it? My #t4032964#? Yeah, this is addressed to me. Oh, thank goodness! Let me just crack this open...

yes.0: Oh no... The contents are all mixed up! Someone else must've opened it first. Was it you? No, I would know if it was you. Must have been a Golem, then... Which means the missing item is still at the temple.

item.0: Those Golems at the Golem's Temple have my #t4032964#, I just know it! What are they going to do with it, anyway?
